What we changed

RUN #182

The first win

On run #182, Jev defeated Aeonglass, collected rewards at 9 HP, and completed The Architect ending. The game’s saved history confirms the victory.

Why we first called it a loss

The ending screen reported 0 HP and fooled our monitor. We checked the game’s saved history: win: true. The result above comes from that save.

About the data

This page covers the 182 completed runs through September 23, 2026. Wins and losses come from the game’s saved history. Floors, decisions and code versions come from the matching Jev logs. The new Ascension 1 run is excluded. Times are Eastern.

One logged decision can include several Jev calls. Token totals count those calls once, including logged previews and cancelled decisions. A run can span several code versions; dates show the first logged use unless marked otherwise. The chart averages up to ten consecutive runs and groups days by the first decision. Random runs, card unlocks and manual recoveries varied, so this chart cannot tell us which change helped.

The page contains summarized gameplay data. Raw logs, credentials, account IDs and seeds stay private.
